messages:
julia: Starting preflight for the weekend change window. Planning to pin runtime v2.14.1 and router v1.9.0-hotfix for a staged cutover. Change window 2026-03-25 02:00-03:30 UTC. API + Console teams please confirm any blockers. deploy-bot, can you queue a canary?

deploy-bot: queued canary wave w-20260325-07 for 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z. Auto-rollback: disabled (manual preferred). Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation at 10%.

sam: quick flag — router v1.9 had a kv-eviction tweak last month that produced transient 429s in east-1 under burst. Are we sure v1.9.0 is safe?

kevin: I recommend router 1.9.0-hotfix (sha a1b2c3d) for east-1, and 1.9.0 elsewhere. Hotfix avoids the recompile path that triggered the evictions.

maria: Console has a small DB migration planned at 02:15 for index cleanup (15m readonly window). Can we shift the canary to start after that completes?

julia: good catch — move canary start to 02:30 UTC to avoid read-only conflicts. Change window end remains 03:30. deploy-bot please update schedule.

deploy-bot: schedule updated. Canary start: 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z. Wave w-20260325-07. Canary length: 30m at 10% initial.

leo: Rollback criteria proposal: trigger manual rollback if any of the following happen during canary: p99 latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m, absolute error rate increase >= 0.5%, or token cost spike >15% vs baseline. Also immediate rollback on sustained 5xx anomalies.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for that window (ops-oncall). I'll keep the pager open until 03:45 UTC. If we need escalation, ping me directly.

sam: Metrics to watch: router p50/p95/p99, runtime KV miss rate, API 5xx rate, console DB connection pool usage. Can we create a temporary alert for KV miss >3% for 5m?

kevin: adding a temp alert now: KV_miss_rate > 3% for 5m -> page ops-oncall. Also adding a p99 delta alert for router.

julia: Release notes checklist (short): 1) pin variants (runtime+router) 2) post migration status 3) temp alerts in place 4) deploy-bot scheduled 5) manual rollback playbook linked. I'll post notes to #releases after pins.

julia: Deploy commands i'll run (copy):
```
# pin router in regions
./deploy pin --service router --version 1.9.0-hotfix --region eu-west-1,us-east-1
# schedule canary
deploy-bot schedule --wave w-20260325-07 --start 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z --traffic 10,50,100
```

deploy-bot: wave w-20260325-07 STARTED at 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z. Step 1: 10% traffic to router 1.9.0-hotfix in us-east-1. Monitoring window 30m.

maria: Console migration completed at 02:13 UTC, post-migration checks green. :white_check_mark:

sam: 12m in: p99 up ~80ms but under our 200ms threshold. No action yet. KV miss steady.

leo: Manual rollback playbook uploaded: https://runbooks/internal/pinwalk-20260325 (steps, rollback commands, contact list).

julia: Decision: proceed with 10% for 30m, hold decision point at +30m, then move to 50% if no regressions. If any rollback criteria tripped, we cut traffic and follow playbook. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: noted. I will confirm once at +30m and again at +60m.

kevin: post-mortem note: keep router 1.9.0-hotfix pinned in east-1 for 48h before full variant swap, to reduce churn.

julia: thanks team — i'll post a short release note and mark the wave as managed. Will update thread with final outcome after the 50% shift.
